records.rationale: The finding is accurate. records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:34 — Removing the PATCH-specific handler causes membership PATCH requests containing changes.add or changes.delete to return success without changing membership.
records.rationale: The diff shows the controller changed from expecting nested params like `params[:group][:name]` to flat params like `params[:name]`. In the old code (visible in the removed lines), `create` used `params[:group][:name]` and `update_put` used `payload = params[:group]`. The new code uses `params[:name]`, `params[:visible]`, etc. directly.
